column3: Saori Route ・ My Parent's Words
It has been a few days after I met Saori in Akihabara.
Since then, I have not been in contact with her.
She won't pick up her cell phone or log into the chat.
She hasn't been on any social network sites, and hasn't contacted Kirino or anyone else.
With nothing to do, I spent my days staring at my silent cellphone.
What's wrong, having a staring contest with your phone?
Not really...
Fufu... Manami is your neighbor. If you're worried, why don't you go see her?
What is she talking about all of a sudden? Ah, she must have misunderstood why I was looking at my cellphone.
Manami and I aren't like that.
Yes, yes, I know.
Why does this old hag think Manami and I are dating?
I don't know how many times I told her we don't have that kind of relationship.
Sure, I like Manami, but not in that way.
Besides, I have the right to decide that!
The right to decide, huh...
Hey, just what if though...
If your daughter went and got married, what would you think?
I mean, married in a way you don't want.
Huh? Why are you asking this so suddenly?
Just roll with it. I'm just curious.
Hmmm... At the least, I...
Think that Kirino would not do that.
She sure is confident...
You think so too, right?
Yeah...
Exactly as my mother says...
If it was Kirino, this kind of blunder wouldn't happen.
My mother trusts Kirino, so she can say that with complete confidence.
Well, I'm going shopping now.
Watch the house for me, alright?
One's own daughter...
Speaking of which, what do Saori's parents think of the engagement...
Saori said it was for the "Honor of my parents," but...
Hmm...
That night...
I tried having the same conversation with my dad who just came home.
Hey, just what if though...
If there was this really good person...
And because she thought it was for her parents' sake, she followed them to the dot.
To the point that it starts messing with her own life...
If this was your child, what would you do?
...Are we talking about Kirino?
Of course not. This is just a hypothetical question.
Besides, I said someone who was a good person!
Stay within some bounds of doting on your daughter, damn old man!
Which I would never say even if my mouth was torn open, but...
Hypothetical, huh...
...【The Misery of a Child】 is a parent's responsibility.
What do you mean?
How a kid grows is their own choice.
But the compass that guides them is their parents.
A child is the closest thing to your own existence that you raise.
The closest thing to yourself, huh...
I remembered Saori.
Who is closest to Saori, since she lives alone in an apartment?
Who is supporting her? Who is her compass?
I believed I knew Saori, but...
I hadn't the faintest, slightest idea.
But, that's why...
Parents who bring their children misfortune are resented for the rest of their lives.
So it's like that?
Parents who think about things other than their children are useless.
After putting his eyes on his newspaper, he said nothing more.
In my bed, I started remembering what my dad said.
The Misery of a Child is a parent's responsibility. "Parents who think about things other than their children are useless."
What about Saori's parents?
Do they not think anything of forcing their daughter into a marriage she doesn't want?
...Tch.
I casually look at my cellphone, expecting to see some sort of update.
No new mail, no notifications.
There was nothing I could do to solve the problem in my own mind.
